provenance: RUST-ONLY fixture. The real stderr of capture children (`gst-launch-1.0 libcamerasrc …`) taken from the agent journals of the support-other-camera-models bench sessions of 2026-11-21 (plan evidence: bench2-imx335-live part 5a and 5b, cm4-imx708 part 5), the `[video-capture camN] ` prefix removed, one child per case. `lastError` is the line the report must carry for that child: its first ERROR line that is not on the skip list (`camera_truth::ERROR_LINES_SKIPPED`). No device identifiers, coordinates or credentials: libcamera timestamps, thread ids and device-tree paths only.
